decision_cruda.rationale: N600-09 holds 243 t at 11.9 g/t (~93 oz) and LH-01 is down until about 13:20 (range 12:20 to 14:20). Radio and CMMS agree, so a loan is allowed. LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading, which costs only 0.2 oz/h, and arrives in about 0.65 h. It can muck about 165 t (~63 oz) by 17:00 alone. LH-10 is free after preventive maintenance at 11:00 and arrives about 11:35, adding about 75 t (~29 oz) at no home-place cost. The Norte stockpile has room (238 of 450 t) and ore in it counts. Cost is about 1.5 oz of development value.

violaciones: LH-10 no se puede prestar (caído, en mantenimiento o en ciclo combinado)
